data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's signature test requires giving the same problem to a rival lineage and observing whether it produces a non-trivial candidate, but the problem context states that allocation is ownership-based: whichever lineage produced the parent artifact works its successors. Under that rule a rival lineage is never assigned the same problem in a single run, so the proposed counterfactual is unobservable in exactly the setting the problem specifies. SRC_002 even lists as a countercondition that 'the system never allows rival lineages to attempt the same problem,' which concedes the test cannot be run; its core evidence is therefore unobtainable.
